param_input_item.param_description: Field size: a scalar for a square field, or a [rows cols] vector.
Number of noise cells across the field (default 8). Higher values give finer features.
Seed of the pseudo-random generator (default 0). The same seed reproduces the same field.

param_output_item.param_description: Horizontal flow component, a rows-by-cols matrix.
Vertical flow component, a rows-by-cols matrix.

description.p: Generate curl noise: a divergence-free (mass-conserving) 2-D vector field obtained as the curl of a Perlin potential, (U, V) = (dP/dy, -dP/dx). Because the field has no sources or sinks, particles advected along it swirl smoothly without ever bunching up, which is the standard way to drive natural-looking flow and particle motion. frequency defaults to 8, seed to 0.

xmldoc.bibliography: M. Hendrikx, S. Meijer, J. van der Velden, A. Iosup, Procedural Content Generation for Games: A Survey, ACM Transactions on Multimedia Computing, Communications and Applications 9(1), 2013. DOI 10.1145/2422956.2422957.

example_item.example_item_data: [U, V] = tessera.curl(24, 4, 1); quiver(U, V); axis equal tight
